text:
ashley: kicking off staged rollout -> 12% traffic to model: redwood/model-v3.1-quant. change window 03:00-04:00 UTC. monitoring 5m.

deploy-bot: rollout id=rl-5864123456 started — target=12% routes=[text-gen, embeddings].

raja: seeing 95p tail on embeddings up from ~180ms -> ~420ms in last 2m. also a few 502s in eu-west.

ashley: holding. pausing further increases. can we pin traffic back if trend continues? :raised_hand:

sre-oncall: please paste the metrics query and span ids. I'm checking redis hitrate and kv-cache OOMs. also can we reduce batch_size for embeds?

jamie: quick check: `redwoodctl route get rl-5864123456 --json | jq .weights`

raja: output: `{'embeddings':0.12, 'text-gen':0.12}`

deploy-bot: traffic shifted: text-gen=12%, embeddings=12% (timestamp=2025-03-05T03:12:36Z)

sre-oncall: looks like kv-cache miss rate spiked ~3x. suggest throttle-add: `redwoodctl rollout update rl-5864123456 --throttle=0.5` to slow requests and prevent tail amplification.

ashley: do it. if errors persist we rollback to stable-20250304. who can approve immediate rollback?

ops: I'm +1 to rollback if 95p doesn't drop under 300ms in 10m.

jamie: done: `redwoodctl rollout update rl-5864123456 --throttle=0.5` — applied.

raja: still seeing error rate creeping to 1.8% (baseline 0.2%). hold + quickvote?

ashley: quickvote — rollback now if no improvement in 4m. react with :+1: to rollback, :-1: to continue.

ops: :+1:

sre-oncall: :+1:

jamie: :+1:

raja: :+1: (opened a trace: trace_id=abc123efg)

ashley: ok executing rollback -> `deployctl rollback --to-tag=stable-20250304 --id rl-5864123456`

deploy-bot: rollback started (rl-5864123456) — target=stable-20250304

deploy-bot: rollback completed — all traffic back to stable-20250304, error-rate normalized. uptime unaffected.

ashley: thanks team. I'll open a short postmortem and re-run canary with `batch_size=8` and `kv_cache_warmup=true` next attempt. note: release notes link: https://redwood/services/releases/2025-03-05

sre-oncall: capture metrics window and schedule infra followup. tagging eng-runtime.

ashley: closing thread. :white_check_mark:
